description: This file defines the 'FilterField' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system, complete with Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping. It includes properties, constructor, and getter/setter methods for managing filter fields in reports.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: An entity representing a filter field that can be used in report querying, with properties for field details and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the filter field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the filter field.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Associates a ReportGroup entity with this filter field.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the filter field.

methods.name: getWhereClausePart
methods.description: Returns the where clause part used in filtering data.

methods.name: setWhereClausePart
methods.description: Sets the where clause part for the filter.

methods.name: getFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the widget type associated with this filter field.

methods.name: setFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget type for this filter field.

methods.name: getConditionNo
methods.description: Returns the condition number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setConditionNo
methods.description: Sets the condition number for filtering logic.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Checks if the filter field is mandatory.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Marks the filter field as required or optional.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the CSS class name associated with the filter field.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the CSS class name for the filter field.
